title: Remove Project.engramCleanupWarning: never set since the grant subsystem was deleted (tm-zykn)
outcome:
tm-zykn deleted the only writers of Project.engram_cleanup_warning: the background authority-revocation degraded notice, and the project-fence-release degraded notice from the deferred grant-rotation release. The field is still persisted and on the wire (src/wire.rs Project; src/state_inner.rs init; UI ui/src/types.ts engramCleanupWarning, rendered in ui/src/EngramProjectSettingsPanel.tsx ~326). A store written before tm-zykn may still carry an old warning text, which nothing clears any more.

Remove the field end to end: backend, wire, UI type and panel, plus any tests. A persisted value is dropped on load (no migration: PersistedState and Project have no deny_unknown_fields). Kept out of tm-zykn because ui/ was held by the tm-ncc6.13.3/.8 card and wait UI work (types.ts overlap); do it after that lands.
